summary: Deck mixer continuity: the deck audiomixer is built live (force-live) with a fixed S16LE deck bus, so its timeline keeps pace through a zero-deck idle and the first song after an idle airs promptly instead of waiting behind a catch-up of about idle/4.5. Test-only: the r0145 release contract skips its three source-object comparisons in a public clone. Restart the engine only; no migration, package, static, unit or protected-runtime change.
